Investor Vijay Kedia Increases Stake in Small-Cap Stock

Investor Vijay Kedia, through his firm Kedia Securities, has acquired a significant stake in Iware Supplychain Services. The purchase involved nearly 5 lakh shares, representing 4.3% of the company's equity, valued at approximately ₹17.44 crore. This investment has coincided with the stock hitting a 5% upper circuit for the second consecutive day.
